verses.1: And Solomon counted that there were seventy thousand men who labored, and another hundred thousand men who worked in the mines. And there were also three thousand people who were killed in those mines.
verses.2: And Solomon sent messengers to Hurram, the king of Syria, saying, “As you have done to my father David, so also send gifts for his wives in the house where they will live.”
verses.3: Now, I shall offer sacrifices to the LORD our God, so that He may sanctify them. I shall burn incense before Him, and offer offerings every day, morning and evening, for His Sabbaths, as well as for all the festivals and celebrations of the LORD our God, forever. This is what I will do for Israel.
verses.4: And the house I build will be great, because it will be greater than all our gods.
verses.5: And who can stop the power that grows within him in the house? For neither the heavens nor the skies can contain him. And who am I, that I can build a house for him? Only by burning incense before him can I do so.
verses.6: And now, send me a wise man who can work with gold, silver, copper, brass, iron, and other metals. He must also know how to open locks using the skills of those wise men who are with me in Judah and Jerusalem. These are the people who were prepared by our father David.
verses.7: And send me cedars, cypress trees, and aloes from Lebanon. For I know that your servants know how to recognize cedar trees. And now, my servants will work together with your servants.
verses.8: And they provided me with many trees. The house I’m building is very large and impressive.
verses.9: And behold, I have given you sheep to eat from the trees. You shall take these sheep and use them as food for your servants. There are forty thousand sheep, and twenty thousand goats. There are also forty thousand chickens in the houses. And there are forty thousand ducks in the houses.
verses.10: And Huraam, king of Zion, wrote this letter. He sent it to Solomon out of love for Jehovah. He gave him command over his people.
verses.11: And Huraam said, “Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who created the heavens and the earth. He gave them to David, the king, who was wise and intelligent. He will build a house for Jehovah, and a house for his kingdom.”
verses.12: And now, I have sent a wise man who knows how to guide my father.
verses.13: A son of Dan’s daughters, and his father is a wise man. He knows how to work with gold, silver, bronze, stones, and wood. He can also make tools, machinery, and other objects. He can open any lock or key. He can think of every possible solution when given the opportunity to do so. He is like your father David’s wise men.
verses.14: And now, the oxen and the sheep, the donkey and the hamster—all those whom Adonai said to be His servants.
verses.15: And we will cut down trees from the Lebanon, just as you require. Then we will bring them to you as offerings on a beautiful boat. And you will carry them to Jerusalem.
verses.16: And Solomon listed all the people of Israel who lived in the land of Israel. This was after David, his father, had made a list of them. He found that there were one hundred and fifty thousand three thousand six hundred people.
verses.17: And he made seventy thousand slaves and two hundred thousand soldiers for the army. He also made three thousand men who could kill people as part of his army.
